review_notes: Reviewed all 93 lines, the cone and chart definitions, integration helpers, volume API, and uses. The proposed generalisations follow the existing proofs but were not checked by executing Lean.

findings.excerpt:
lemma sphereCone_injOn (p : Sphere) {s : Set E2} (hs : s ⊆ (extChartAt I2 p).target) :
    InjOn (sphereCone p) (join '' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ s)) := by
findings.problem: Both geometric helpers unnecessarily restrict the radial domain to the unit interval. Injectivity needs only strictly positive radii, while the image identity works for any set of radii. The unit upper bound belongs to the subsequent volume calculation, not these geometric facts.
findings.proposed_change:
Generalise the statements to:

lemma sphereCone_injOn (p : Sphere) {s : Set E2}
    (hs : s ⊆ (extChartAt I2 p).target) :
    InjOn (sphereCone p) (join '' (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ s))

lemma sphereCone_image (p : Sphere) (s : Set Sphere) (R : Set ℝ) :
    sphereCone p '' (join '' (R ×ˢ chartPreimage p s)) =
      R • ((Subtype.val : Sphere → E3) '' (s ∩ (extChartAt I2 p).source))

For injectivity, retain the proof and replace uses of hr.1 and ht.1 by hr and ht. The image proof carries radial membership unchanged and needs no other alteration. Recover the unit-domain injectivity at line 55 using Set.InjOn.mono and the inclusion induced by (0,1) ⊆ (0,∞); instantiate R with (0,1) for the image formula. Keep zero excluded from injectivity because all angular coordinates collapse there. The image identity remains valid for empty R and for zero or negative radii, without measurability assumptions.
findings.benefit: Users can reuse the same chart geometry for arbitrary-radius truncated cones, spherical shells, and the full positive cone without reproving injectivity or the image identity.
